# DEC-20261021-HOURLY-TIER-PRICING

## Context

Cùng ngày, Rocky đã chọn Phương án B (giá theo phiên). Sau đó Rocky yêu cầu đổi sang mô hình
3 tầng theo giờ, giống gói của các ứng dụng AI. Chi tiết:
[2026-10-21-Hourly-Tier-Pricing-Basic-Premium-VIP](../Brand-Strategy/Offers-Pricing/2026-10-21-Hourly-Tier-Pricing-Basic-Premium-VIP.md).

## Decision

| Tầng | Giá | Tối thiểu | Gồm |
|---|---|---|---|
| Basic | $30/giờ | 1h | 1 khu; toàn bộ ảnh gốc; 10–15 ảnh chỉnh sửa/giờ |
| Premium | $60/giờ | 2h | Basic + 2–3 khu, trang điểm nhẹ, video recap ≤60s, 1 polaroid, 20 ảnh chỉnh sửa/giờ |
| VIP | $99/giờ | 2h | Premium + trang phục, video dài 2–3 phút, 5 polaroid, 30 ảnh chỉnh sửa/giờ |

- Tối đa 2 khách, từ khách thứ 3: +$15/giờ/người.
- Ảnh gốc giao trong 24h; ảnh chỉnh sửa và video giao trong 48h.
- Taxi giữa các khu do khách trả.

## Superseded

`DEC-20261021-UNIFIED-PHOTO-WALK-PRICING` (Phương án B) không còn hiệu lực; giữ làm lịch sử.

## Not decided

Trang điểm/trang phục cho 1 hay 2 khách; mức cọc và thanh toán; Express 24h; chi phí thợ thực tế.

## Approval Evidence

Rocky, chat hiện tại, 2026-10-21: "30$ (gói cơ bản); 60$ (gói cao cấp); 99$/giờ (gói vip)… xây
dựng theo hướng này đi". Sau đó chọn: tối thiểu Basic 1h / Premium 2h / VIP 2h; tối đa 2 khách,
+$15/giờ/người; ảnh chỉnh sửa tính theo giờ, giao 48h; Basic 1 khu, Premium/VIP 2–3 khu.

publicService.text: Hanoi photoshoot Hanoi Photoshoot with a Private Local Photographer Private, candid photoshoots in Hanoi with a local photographer-guide. Phone or professional-camera packages, priced per hour, with routes planned around the light. Walk Hanoi with a local who knows where the light falls, and come home with photos where you actually look like yourself. TravelFrame photoshoots are private, unhurried and candid: we explore the Old Quarter, the French Quarter and the lakes together, and capture you in between the moments, not frozen in stiff poses. Plan my photoshoot: message PHOTO on Instagram · WhatsApp 0925148581 · Build your estimate Why travelers book a Hanoi photoshoot with us Photographer and local guide in one. You get the stories behind the streets, the cafés locals actually use, and someone who handles the traffic while you enjoy the walk. Candid, documentary style. No awkward posing marathons. Gentle direction when you want it, natural moments the rest of the time. Private, never a group. Just you, your partner or your friends. Clear pricing. You pick a visual package and a duration, see the estimate before you book, and the final price is confirmed with you in writing. Photoshoot packages Choose how you want to be photographed, then how long you want to walk. Photo Phone: 8 USD / 210,000 VND per hour. Shot on iPhone; all photos and clips delivered within 1 hour. Explorer: 20 USD / 520,000 VND per hour. Professional camera; 10 edited photos within 2 days. Complete (most popular): 50 USD / 1,300,000 VND per hour. Professional camera; 25 retouched photos within 3 days + 1 short video (under 1 minute). VIP: 80 USD / 2,080,000 VND per hour. Professional camera; 50 retouched photos within 3 days + 1 cinematic video (under 3 minutes). Walk length and group size come from the tour package: Experience (2 hours, 1 guest), Standard (3 hours, 1–2 guests) or Plus (4 hours, 1–3 guests). Example: a 3-hour Standard walk with the Complete package is estimated at 300 USD before add-ons. Build your estimate . Prefer a fully planned route? See The Cinematic Hanoi photography tour (3 hours). Where we shoot Every route is planned around the light, your pace and current local conditions. Popular backdrops include: Old Quarter lanes : weathered shopfronts, craft streets, tube houses and hidden cafés. Hoàn Kiếm Lake and the Huc Bridge : best in soft morning light. French Quarter and the Opera House : colonial facades and wide boulevards. Long Biên Bridge and the Phùng Hưng railway arches : Hanoi's railway heritage, photographed from public areas. St. Joseph's Cathedral, Temple of Literature, West Lake : on longer walks. Note on Train Street: we do not include or guarantee access to the residential railway corridor. Access changes and authorities enforce the railway safety zone. Read our Train Street safety guide . More ideas in our 15 best photo spots in Hanoi . Who it's for Solo travelers Traveling alone usually means a camera roll of landscapes and arm's-length selfies. A photo walk gives you real photos of yourself, and a local companion for a few hours. Read: natural photos without awkward posing . Couples and honeymooners Relaxed couple photos as you wander, not a staged pre-wedding set. Read: couple and honeymoon photoshoot in Hanoi . Creators and digital nomads Need fresh content in Hanoi? Tell us the look and the formats you need, and we plan the route around them. How it works Message us on Instagram (send "PHOTO") or WhatsApp with your dates and the look you want. We plan the route around light, weather and your priorities, and confirm package, duration and price in writing. Meet in the Old Quarter and walk. We photograph along the way. Receive your photos in the time stated for your package. What to wear Solid, contrasting colors photograph best against Hanoi's yellow walls and green shutters. Bring comfortable shoes, sunglasses or a vintage accessory, and a relaxed mindset. Cover shoulders and knees if we visit temples. Frequently asked questions I'm awkward in front of the camera. Will this work for me? Yes. We photograph you while you explore, so most shots are natural moments rather than poses. We give light direction only when you want it. How long should my photoshoot be? Two hours covers one area of the Old Quarter. Three to four hours lets us combine the Old Quarter with the lake or French Quarter at a relaxed pace. When will I get my photos? Photo Phone: within 1 hour. Explorer: 10 edited photos within 2 days. Complete and VIP: retouched photos within 3 days. What time of day is best? Early morning (soft light, fewer crowds) or late-afternoon golden hour. We suggest a time once we know your dates and the forecast. Can you take us to Train Street? We don't include or guarantee the residential railway corridor. We can photograph Hanoi's railway heritage from public areas such as the Phùng Hưng arches or Long Biên Bridge. What if it rains? We adjust the route toward covered streets, cafés and arcades, or reschedule. The rain policy is confirmed in writing when you book. How do I book? tourEvidence.name: Hanoi Early Bird: Sunrise & Local Markets
tourEvidence.description: Start your day before the city wakes up. This 5-hour morning tour captures the raw energy of Hanoi’s dawn, from historic bridges to bustling wholesale markets.

overview.bodyHtml: Experience the authentic awakening of Hanoi. We begin at the historic Long Bien Bridge at sunrise, perfect for high-contrast and monochrome photography, before diving into the energetic chaos of the morning markets. The route seamlessly weaves through the Old Quarter's narrow alleys, ending with a classic, comforting bowl of local Pho.
overview.photoVideo: Street photography with a focus on dramatic morning light
excluded: Hotel pickup outside the Old Quarter
bring: Light jacket for cool early mornings
Minimal bags for easy movement in crowded markets

faq.q: Why does this tour start so early?
faq.a: 5:30 AM is the perfect time to catch the magical morning light and see the wholesale markets at their busiest and most authentic state.

points.name: Egg Coffee - Dong Duong Station Coffee
points.story: Hanoi’s signature coffee creation with a creamy twist.
points.tip: The antique Indochine-style interior with retro wooden furniture offers a nostalgic Hanoi vibe for close-up portraits while you wait for the train. Sip your rich hot egg coffee slowly and ask the staff for the exact train timetable to set up your shot in advance.

points.tip: Stroll slowly along the street to enjoy the festive atmosphere and ask politely before taking close-up photos at local decoration shops. Perfect for vibrant night portraits!

points.name: Dong Xuan Market
points.story: Hanoi’s largest traditional market and a paradise for local shopping.
points.tip: Hanoi's largest wholesale market! Stroll through the bustling ground-floor food alleys for delicious local snacks, or capture vibrant street portraits right outside the iconic arched facade.

points.name: Ngoc Son Temple
points.story: A historic temple located on a peaceful island in Hoan Kiem Lake.
points.tip: Modest clothing is required inside the sanctuary. Cross the red wooden bridge early in the morning to enjoy a peaceful atmosphere and clean, crowd-free portrait shots.

points.name: Huyen Huong Chicken Pho
points.story: A traditional chicken pho experience with a light and flavorful broth.
points.tip: Phở Gà Huyền Hương is renowned for its rich, fragrant broth and premium, tender chicken. Be sure to customize your bowl with some fresh lime and chili. It is a highly popular local spot, so arriving slightly before peak meal times guarantees you get the best cuts of meat and a comfortable seat.

We treat the streets of Hanoi as a dynamic set, utilizing professional-grade equipment to capture everything from sweeping architectural angles to intimate, compressed telephoto details. Whether you prefer vibrant, color-graded street scenes or timeless monochrome aesthetics that let your emotions stand out, this tour is purely about crafting high-end visual art with you at the center.

Prefer a shorter or phone-based shoot? See all Hanoi photoshoot packages.

faq.q: I am awkward in front of the camera. Will this work for me?
faq.a: Absolutely. We specialize in documentary storytelling, meaning we capture natural, unposed moments as you explore the city, rather than forcing stiff poses.

points.name: Trang Tien Ice Cream
points.story: First ever established ice cream store in Hanoi back in 60's
points.tip: Try the iconic Green Rice (Cốm) or Coconut popsicles! Grab your ice cream and enjoy it right on the sidewalk like a true Hanoi local.

points.name: Hanoi Post Office
points.story: Located near Hoan Kiem Lake, Hanoi Post Office is a charming historical landmark featuring classic French architecture.
points.tip: Best photographed from across Hoan Kiem Lake or along Dinh Tien Hoang street. Visit in the afternoon when warm sunlight highlights its iconic retro architecture!

points.name: Hoan Kiem Lake
points.story: Hoan Kiem Lake is the spiritual heart of Hanoi, surrounded by historic landmarks, peaceful walking paths, and local daily life.
points.tip: Best visited in early morning for peaceful local vibes, or at night when Turtle Tower lights up. Walk along the lake for great photo spots!
